name: Oprost
storyline:
For hundreds of years, circles of druids have been tasked with leading the spirits of the dead to the spiritual world.
Suddenly, 40 days after the death of a powerful druid, Elara, a mysterious beast of roots and dirt appeared. The beast seemingly aimed to destroy the forest and its inhabitants.
Elara's husband, another powerful druid, Arik, is the only one who can, together with the forest creatures, stop the beast and put all souls to rest.

Oprost is a journey of grief through a precision platformer that uses power of animal moves instead of classic jumping. Help Arik, a druid who recently lost his wife, in battling his grief as well as the beast of thorns and weeds who is destroying his forest.
summary: Use the souls of fallen animals to jump, fly, and dash through a decaying forest, chasing the monster that is tearing it apart
